tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for files by name on the local disk of this computer. Matches file names only, not their contents. Do not use this for finding text inside local files, finding a file in the cloud drive or listing recently modified local files.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find text inside files on the local disk. Returns each file and line where the phrase appears; does not match file names. Do not use this for finding a local file by its name, finding a file in the cloud drive or listing recently modified local files.

tools.name: locate_files
tools.description: Locate files by name in the user's cloud drive (synced online storage). Does not look at the local disk. Do not use this for finding a local file by its name, finding text inside local files or listing recently modified local files.

tools.name: query_files
tools.description: List files on the local disk that were modified within the last N days, newest first. Do not use this for finding a local file by its name, finding text inside local files or finding a file in the cloud drive.
